description: This PHP class defines the I18NTranslation entity used within the OrangeHRM application to represent translation data for internationalization. It includes properties for language string, language, translation value, modification date, and customized flag, along with ORM mappings and utility traits.

classes.name: I18NTranslation
classes.description: Entity class representing a translation of a language string into a specific language, with properties for value, modification date, and customization status, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the translation.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the translation.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Returns the associated language string entity.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string entity with this translation.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language entity for this translation.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language entity for this translation.

methods.name: isCustomized
methods.description: Checks if the translation has been customized.

methods.name: setCustomized
methods.description: Marks the translation as customized or not.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the translation was last modified.

methods.name: setModifiedAt
methods.description: Sets the last modified date and time for the translation.
